title: Keep one continuum open while closing all unwanted internal-spin branches
statement: An exact F_z rotating frame for circular polarization and parity of magnetic quantum number divide the entire finite hyperfine manifold into two sectors; unintended continua are genuinely above the admitted native energy.

body: For the selected stretched pair, rotating offsets are r*hbar*omega in the lower manifold and -Lambda+r*hbar*omega in the upper. Spectator offsets are at least Delta_hf. D_x changes magnetic number by one and therefore swaps parity. The deliberately open target gets the original divided source, while spectator components use actual closed-channel resolvents. The reduced native-sector resolvent supplies the next dressing. Signed spectator bounds leave the nonaffine phase invariant nonzero. Exact circular polarization/common potentials are premises; off-axis longitudinal fields, ellipticity and electric fields are not thereby removed.
